title: VPN Setup Guide
content: Install the company VPN client from the IT software portal. Sign in with your corporate SSO credentials. Connect before accessing internal apps, file shares, or production systems. If connection fails, reboot and clear the VPN cache, then contact IT if the issue persists.

title: Password Reset
content: Reset your password at https://password.ampcus.internal or via the Microsoft self-service portal. Passwords must be at least 14 characters with mixed case, a number, and a symbol. Passwords expire every 90 days. Locked accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes or via IT helpdesk.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
content: MFA is required for all employees. Use the company authenticator app or hardware key. Lost phone: contact IT to temporarily enroll a backup method. Do not share MFA codes with anyone, including IT staff.

title: Laptop Request
content: New or replacement laptops are requested via the IT Service Catalog. Standard issue is a company-managed Windows or MacBook. Approvals: manager then IT asset owner. Typical delivery is 5–7 business days.

title: Software Installation
content: Approved software is available in the Company Portal / Self Service app. Unlisted software requires an IT security review ticket. Do not install pirated or personal unlicensed software on company devices.

title: Phishing Reporting
content: Report suspicious email with the Report Phish button in Outlook. Do not click links or open attachments. IT Security investigates all reports. Confirmed phishing is blocked org-wide.

title: Office Wi-Fi
content: Connect to Ampcus-Corp using SSO. Guest network Ampcus-Guest is for visitors only and has no access to internal systems. For conference rooms use Ampcus-Corp with your device certificate.

title: IT Incident Severity
content: P1: production outage affecting many users — call the on-call bridge. P2: major feature degraded. P3: single-user or minor issue — submit a ticket. Data breach suspicion is always treated as P1 and escalated to security.

title: Office Printers by Location
content: Office printer: TOSHIBA e-STUDIO3505AC-11965425 at IPP endpoint http://10.1.0.22:50081/ipp/print (color, duplex, staple, 35 ppm). To print from chat, upload a PDF and say 'print this'. Conference rooms: Room A (12 seats, Teams Room), Room B (6 seats), Room C (20 seats). Walk-up printing: badge at the device to release your job.

title: Conference Rooms
content: Conference rooms at Ampcus Office: Room A (12 seats, Teams Room, HDMI), Room B (6 seats, display only), Room C (20 seats, video conferencing). Book via chat ('book a conference room tomorrow at 2pm') or Outlook room calendars. Rooms auto-release 15 minutes after start if no check-in.

title: Office Wi-Fi Details
content: Corporate SSID: Ampcus-Corp — authenticate with SSO (same as laptop login). Guest SSID: Ampcus-Guest — visitor name + sponsor email; no internal access. Conference room TVs and printers require Ampcus-Corp with device certificate (install via Company Portal). Password is not used for Ampcus-Corp; use your corporate identity. If Wi-Fi fails after password change, forget the network and rejoin.

title: Parking and Commute
content: New York HQ: Garage levels B1–B2, badge access; visitor parking on street level with front desk validation. Austin: Surface lot — register plate with facilities. London: No on-site parking; nearest NCP on Baker Street. Bangalore: Basement parking — security assigns slot. Toronto: Shared building garage, badge required. Singapore: Limited visitor bays — book 24h ahead via facilities@ampcus.com.

title: Building Access and Badge
content: Office badge hours: Mon–Fri 7:00–20:00 local time at all sites. After-hours entry requires manager-approved access list (submit via IT Service Catalog). Visitors must check in at reception and wear a guest badge. Lost badge: report immediately to security@ampcus.com and facilities; badge is deactivated within 15 minutes.

title: Cafeteria and Amenities
content: New York HQ: Cafeteria 11:30–14:00, coffee bar all day. Austin: Kitchenette only — no full cafeteria. London: Deli partners in building lobby. Bangalore: Full cafeteria 12:00–15:00 IST. All sites: filtered water, mother's room, and prayer/meditation room where marked on floor plans. Ask facilities for dietary accommodation at company events.

title: Conference Room AV Setup
content: Teams Room systems: select 'Join with room device' in Teams; HDMI for laptops is labeled on the table. Non-Teams rooms: use the wall panel to power on display; HDMI cable at the table. If the TV shows 'No signal', press Input until HDMI-1. For wireless presentation, use Microsoft Wireless Display Adapter where installed (NY Room A, London Thames). Report AV issues to IT with room name and time.
